fc_f6_dpi.implementation: A5 05 FC <dpi&0x0F> <cks> by default; for curDevice in {devRainbow2Pro(3), devC2SL(5)} the builder overwrites element 2 with #0x1ec = 0xF6 when the zkmVersion static (0x102c, set from the 0B reply) is >= 0x35, and keeps FC when it is < 0x35 (writeDpiConfig @0x894000)
fc_f6_dpi.note: an earlier note phrased this as 'fw < 0x35 -> F6'; the assembly at 0x8940f4 reads `cmp x1,#0x35; b.lt <skip F6 store>`, i.e. F6 is used when the version is >= 0x35
